# Nibula

> Nibula is an open-source CLI that scaffolds ready-to-build Eleventy projects in seconds — sensible structure, configurable templates, zero boilerplate.

Nibula is a command-line tool that generates ready-to-build Eleventy projects: it sets up folder structure, templates and configuration so you can start writing content immediately. Published on npm, Apache 2.0 licensed, maintained by Michele Garofalo.
